newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fat Brazilian dies after being stuck in bathroom.
newsitem.headline: Fat Brazilian dies after being stuck in bathroom.

text.p: A Brazilian man who weighed more than 770 pounds (350 kg) died this week after being rescued from a bathroom, a local fire department official said on Thursday.
Altair Soares, 33, died in a hospital of breathing difficulties on Wednesday, three days after it took 15 firemen to free him from a bathroom.
It took 10 men to lift Soares' body from the two beds where he had been lying when he died, Edson Paixao, director of Miguel Couto hospital in Rio de Janeiro, said.
Soares was buried in a custom-made coffin that filled two grave sites, cemetery manager Paulo Rodrigues said. "He was extremely fat, his thigh was the size (circumference) of a bicycle tire."
In the past eight years Soares had gained 250 pounds (110 kg) following the death of his godfather, to whom he was very attached, local newspaper O Dia said.
